adjudication.basis: Primary formative evaluation and interface improvement report for an identifiable Linked Open Data exploration browser. Brokering is a broader research question, but the methods and findings directly document human KG exploration.

backend.source_model_description: Actual Linked Open Data and knowledge graphs across four heritage collections; DIVE+ browser and CLARIAH workspace. RDF serialization, query language and storage engine are not specified directly in this report.

descriptions.interaction: Browse media, person, location and concept entities across four Dutch heritage collections; follow semantic relations; search and sort collections; play audiovisual items. Save, load, bookmark and export exploration journeys through a CLARIAH workspace. Newest iteration adds annotations, export and shuffle recommendations.
descriptions.guidance: Entity relations, exploration journey history and collection context support orientation. Earlier tested version lacked sufficient relationship explanations and source context; later annotation/context additions are not evaluated for a measured benefit.
descriptions.visualisation: Entity/media detail displays, audiovisual playback, collection context and recorded exploration journeys. The article does not establish every possible graph-view type.
descriptions.backend: Actual Linked Open Data and knowledge graphs across four heritage collections; DIVE+ browser and CLARIAH workspace. RDF serialization, query language and storage engine are not specified directly in this report.
descriptions.evaluation: Single-system qualitative formative research: workshops, individual search tasks, questionnaires, diaries, focus groups, small group poster journeys and two think-aloud sessions. Research pilot March 2017–July 2018; user workshops May 2017–January 2018.
descriptions.scalability: Four heritage collections. The source prints the entity total as “1,231.688 entities”; mixed punctuation is retained without interpreting it as a normalized count. No measured latency, memory or scalability workload.

report_level_evaluation.design: Single-system qualitative formative research: workshops, individual search tasks, questionnaires, diaries, focus groups, small group poster journeys and two think-aloud sessions. Research pilot March 2017–July 2018; user workshops May 2017–January 2018.
report_level_evaluation.tasks: Humanities researchers explore linked heritage collections with an individual research question, reflect on their search journey and discuss possible interface changes.
report_level_evaluation.measures: Qualitative participant feedback and observations; no controlled tool comparator, task-time, accuracy or success-rate measurements.
report_level_evaluation.results: Participants valued discovering relationships but reported a steep learning curve, counterintuitive interaction and time-consuming exploration, with insufficient relationship explanations, provenance and source context. Findings led to revised terminology and annotation/context features.; limits: The reported 122 workshop participants are distinct from the eight-person project team and 27 project meetings. The 239 coded meeting-text lines are qualitative material, not users or task outcomes. Session overlap with earlier DIVE reports is unresolved; samples must not be pooled. Newest interface changes were not independently evaluated in this report.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Not reported: comparator. The reported 122 workshop participants are distinct from the eight-person project team and 27 project meetings. The 239 coded meeting-text lines are qualitative material, not users or task outcomes. Session overlap with earlier DIVE reports is unresolved; samples must not be pooled. Newest interface changes were not independently evaluated in this report.
